create_TensorDict_from_dict: create a TensorDict from a nested dictionary of PyTorch tensors with automatic conversion
map_TensorDict_leaves: map a function over all leaf tensors in a TensorDict and return a new TensorDict
flatten_TensorDict: flatten a TensorDict into a list of key tuples and leaf tensors for batch operations
transpose_list_of_dicts: transpose a list of dictionaries into a single dictionary of lists recursively
iterate_dicts_recursively: iterate multiple DictTrees recursively and yield tuples of corresponding leaf values
